name: snap-pages
title: Snap pages
description: Full-height sections that snap into place as you scroll, with a dot rail and keyboard paging, on native CSS scroll snap.
docs: One screen tall by default (h-dvh); give it h-full to fill a parent. Give each page its own className for a background, and flex items-center to centre what it holds. Keep the right edge of a page free for the dot rail, around 4rem on a phone. A page taller than the screen scrolls normally and the keys follow it: Page Down moves on only when its end is in view. Reduced motion softens mandatory snapping to proximity and switches off gliding.
